name: Projected Interpolation Degree / VC Dimension
details: For finite binary classes, projected interpolation degree equals VC dimension.
proof: If $S$ is shattered with $|S|=d$, then $\mathcal H_{|S}=\{0,1\}^S$, whose interpolation degree is $d$; hence $\mathrm{intdeg}^p(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$. Conversely, for every projection $\mathcal G=\mathcal H_{|T}$, the established order-shattering bounds give $\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal G)\le\mathrm{OSH}_{\min}(\mathcal G)\le\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal G)\le\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$. Maximizing over $T$ gives the reverse inequality.
